tasks.CalculateDate: Calculate the date one month ago from the given date.

answer: The date a month ago from 07/29/2002 is 06/29/2002, but since June does not have a 29th, the correct date would be adjusted to the last day of June, resulting in 06/30/2002. Given the options provided, the closest match is (A) 06/27/2002.
